name: Fumadocs
description: Fumadocs lets agents search and read the documentation of Fumadocs, the open-source React documentation framework, so they can set up, configure, and extend a Fumadocs site with the current API. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: How do I add Fumadocs to an existing Next.js app?
How do I set up search with Orama in Fumadocs?
How do I generate API reference pages from an OpenAPI file with Fumadocs?

apps.name: Fumadocs
apps.description: Fumadocs documentation lookup, over the Fumadocs MCP server with no sign-in.
